focus: Six short hard efforts to raise VO2max with no impact and no back load

exercises.name: Easy Spin Warm-Up
exercises.execution: Light resistance, smooth cadence. Raise the effort a little each minute until you are breathing steadily.
exercises.benefit: Warms the legs and brings heart rate up gradually before the hard efforts.

exercises.name: Hard Push 1 of 6
exercises.execution: Raise resistance and push to 8 out of 10 effort. Stay seated. Strong, not an all-out sprint.
exercises.benefit: Short hard efforts push heart and lungs toward their ceiling.

exercises.name: Easy Spin 1 of 6
exercises.execution: Drop the resistance and spin easy. Slow your breathing and let heart rate fall.
exercises.benefit: Recovery keeps every hard push high quality.

exercises.name: Hard Push 2 of 6
exercises.execution: Raise resistance and push to 8 out of 10 effort. Stay seated. Match the first push.

exercises.name: Easy Spin 2 of 6
exercises.execution: Drop the resistance and spin easy. Slow your breathing and let heart rate fall.

exercises.name: Hard Push 3 of 6
exercises.execution: Raise resistance and push to 8 out of 10 effort. Stay seated. Keep the cadence smooth.

exercises.name: Easy Spin 3 of 6
exercises.execution: Drop the resistance and spin easy. Slow your breathing and let heart rate fall.

exercises.name: Hard Push 4 of 6
exercises.execution: Raise resistance and push to 8 out of 10 effort. Stay seated. Same output as the first three.

exercises.name: Easy Spin 4 of 6
exercises.execution: Drop the resistance and spin easy. Slow your breathing and let heart rate fall.

exercises.name: Hard Push 5 of 6
exercises.execution: Raise resistance and push to 8 out of 10 effort. Stay seated. If output drops a lot, end here.

exercises.name: Easy Spin 5 of 6
exercises.execution: Drop the resistance and spin easy. Slow your breathing and let heart rate fall.

exercises.name: Hard Push 6 of 6
exercises.execution: Last one. Raise resistance and push to 8 out of 10 effort. Finish strong, still in control.

exercises.name: Easy Spin 6 of 6
exercises.execution: Drop the resistance and spin easy. Slow your breathing and let heart rate fall.

exercises.name: Cool-Down Spin
exercises.execution: Very light resistance. Nose-breathe and keep the legs turning until your breathing is calm.
exercises.benefit: Brings heart rate down gently so you leave the session calm.
